title: Fence Painting & Staining in Williston, FL
description: Fence painting and staining in Williston, FL for board fences on farm parcels and privacy fences in town. Wash, repair, then stain or paint wood and vinyl.
h1: Fence Painting and Staining in Williston, FL
heroIntro: From long board fences on agricultural land to backyard privacy fences in town, we clean, repair, and coat fencing so it holds up in the Florida sun.

questions: Should I paint or stain my wood fence?
Can you paint a long farm fence?

body: On Williston's agricultural properties, a fence is not a backyard accent. It may run the full edge of a pasture, so fence painting in Williston, FL is often measured in long runs rather than a few panels. On town lots in Williston Highlands or near downtown, it is more often a privacy fence that has gone gray on the sunny side. Both are wood baking in the same sun, and both need the same prep before any coating.

Stain is usually the better choice on raw or weathered wood. A penetrating stain soaks in, so it fades over time instead of peeling, and recoating is simpler. Paint gives a crisp, uniform color and can suit board fences near a house, but it needs sound, well-primed wood to stay attached. We talk through both at the walkthrough and list the chosen product on the estimate.
Vinyl fencing can also be cleaned and coated with the right product when the original color has faded.

bullets: Wash to remove gray fibers, mildew, and dirt
Replace sections that are rotted at grade
Protect landscaping and adjacent surfaces from overspray
Spray and back-brush for full coverage on rough-sawn wood

body: Fences are measured, not guessed. The crew lead walks the line, notes height, board style, which sides get coated, and how much repair is needed, then puts it all on a written estimate. If the fence borders a pasture, one side might need full coverage and the other only a light coat. Gates and posts are listed separately when they need their own repairs. That detail makes it easy to compare options, such as staining the visible road frontage now and the back run next season.
Other work we do in the area is on our Williston service page.

The side of a fence that faces the afternoon sun weathers far faster than the shaded side. Our article on treating a sun-damaged wood fence covers what you can expect to salvage. Fence work goes best in the drier months between October and May.
See our main deck and fence staining in Florida page for products, or add deck staining in Williston to the same visit.

faqs.q: Do you stain long pasture fences in Williston?
faqs.a: Yes. Long board-fence runs on agricultural parcels are something we price by measured length, with prep and product listed in the estimate.

faqs.q: Is paint or stain better for a Florida wood fence?
faqs.a: Stain is usually easier to maintain because it wears instead of peeling. Paint can work well on sound, primed wood when you want a solid color.

faqs.q: Can you fix broken pickets before staining?
faqs.a: Yes. Loose boards are re-secured and rotted sections are replaced during prep.

faqs.q: Can you coat just one side of my fence?
faqs.a: Yes. We can price one side or both, and list each separately so you can decide.
